behavior: Requires first supplied flow_rate to equal zero.
Prepends level = first(level)-1.0 and flow_rate = 0.0 before constructing PCHIPInterpolation.
Uses ConstantExtrapolation left and Linear extrapolation right.

consequence.relation_to_v1: The R2 internal PCHIP knot set is identical to the V1 supplied knot set that produced the measured mapping falsification.
consequence.prediction: R2 should reproduce essentially the same C1/C2 mapping mismatch as V1 and should not pass the frozen equivalence tolerance.

scientific_interpretation: A native TabulatedRatingCurve cannot exactly represent the legacy hard kink Q=max(0, alpha*(h-hcrest)) at the crest when its first supplied flow is zero, because qh_interpolation deliberately smooths the transition by prepending a flat zero-flow segment.
decision_rule: If R2 fails with the V1 signature, close the TabulatedRatingCurve-exact-equivalence route rather than adding arbitrary knots to fit the three frozen cases. Search for a different Ribasim native control/connector representation or explicitly qualify an approximation envelope.
